name: Morgan Plastic Fabrication
old_description: Morgan Plastic Fabrication, Inc. is a midwestern company experienced in manufacturing plastic conveyor components since 1992. Using the highest quality UHMW available and CNC machining to ensure accuracy of our flights, we provide superior parts for your needs in a timely manner. We stock UHMW in virgin and recycled grades.  We have quick access to High Temperature UHMW, Titanium Filled UHMW, Anti-Static UHMW, UV Stable UHMW, High Density PE and Nylons. With our CAD programming, we are able to create a library of your part specifications and requirements for easy re-ordering. Ten or ten thousand parts, we want to be your partner in business.
about:
Morgan Plastic Fabrication, Inc. operates from Lexington, Nebraska, where it was founded in 1992. The midwestern company began as a specialist in plastic conveyor components and has remained focused on that niche for over three decades. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The shop produces drag conveyor flights and paddles machined to customer specifications using CNC equipment. It stocks virgin and reprocessed UHMW in multiple grades—including high-temperature, titanium-filled, anti-static, and UV-stable variants—as well as high-density polyethylene and nylons. CAD programming allows the company to maintain a digital library of part specifications for repeat orders, and it says it runs jobs ranging from ten pieces to ten thousand.

Customers are primarily in industries that use drag conveyors, such as grain handling, feed milling, and other bulk-material applications. The company works from customer drawings, unused sample parts, or its standard order forms to replicate or modify flight designs.

Morgan Plastic Fabrication emphasizes machining accuracy, material availability, and the convenience of a stored part library as its core differentiators. It positions itself as a long-term partner for both scheduled maintenance and emergency repair needs.
